_comment: A three project set, which is the shape we measured with. Copy over projects.json and edit.
The point of more than one project is coverage rather than volume. A stratum needs a population
to be sampled from, and no single project has all of them: a small project you control gives you
answer keys you can hand verify, a large one gives you Blueprint blast radius that isn't trivial,
and a deep one gives you files too big to read. Take each stratum from wherever it is actually
populated rather than forcing every project to answer every group.
Group H is deprecation, and it comes from the engine tree rather than from any project, because
a project with no UE_DEPRECATED in it would give an empty stratum. Set engine_source to your
engine's Source folder to enable it.

projects._comment: Large sample game. Most classes, most Blueprints, so it carries C, E and F.

_comment: Deep plugin. Few classes, very large files. Good for cost, poor for replication:
if only two classes replicate anything, don't ask it group C questions.

projects._comment: Small seed project. The only one whose keys we hand verify, so it carries the hand checked blast radius.
